name: Lyrics
author: Carmine Paolino
description: Lyrics for whatever is already playing, following the song line by line. Reads the track from MPRIS, so there is nothing to search for.

barWidget.description: Lyrics for the song that is playing, highlighted in time with it.

schema.label: Expanded width (% of screen)
schema.description: How wide the reader grows when expanded with the button in its header. It always opens compact.

schema.label: Expanded height (% of screen)
schema.description: The tallest the reader may grow when expanded. Short lyrics still shrink the panel to fit.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is playing
schema.description: Keep the bar clear until a player reports a track.
